_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "habits" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "category" TEXT NULL, "frequency" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "end_date" INTEGER NULL, "repeat_forever" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("repeat_forever" IN (0, 1)), "repeat_days" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "type" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "scheduled_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "habit_completions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "habit_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES habits (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "completion_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "streaks" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "max_streak" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_updated" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "streak_history_entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "streak_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES streaks (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reached_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sleep_logs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "hours" REAL NOT NULL, "date" INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "mood_entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "content" TEXT NOT NULL, "date" INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pomodoro_sessions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "category" TEXT NULL, "purpose" TEXT NULL, "cycles" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 4, "focus_duration" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 25, "break_duration" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 5, "completed_cycles" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "started_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "projects" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "parent_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES projects (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "board_columns" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "project_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "built_in_key" TEXT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "counts_as_done" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("counts_as_done" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "todo_tasks" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "category" TEXT NULL, "start_date" INTEGER NULL, "due_date" INTEGER NULL, "priority" TEXT NOT NULL, "column_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES board_columns (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "project_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "completed_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "task_comments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "task_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES todo_tasks (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "content" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "task_checklist_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "task_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES todo_tasks (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "content" TEXT NOT NULL, "done" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("done" IN (0, 1)), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "nutrition_goals" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'singleton', "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "calories" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 2000, "protein" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 120, "carbs" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 220, "fat" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 70, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "food_entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "portion" TEXT NULL, "calories" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "protein" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "carbs" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "fat" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "meal" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "food_entry_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "entry_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES food_entries (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "grams" REAL NOT NULL, "calories_per100g" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "protein_per100g" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "carbs_per100g" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "fat_per100g" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "foods" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "lower_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "calories_per100g" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "protein_per100g" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "carbs_per100g" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "fat_per100g" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "is_built_in" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_built_in" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "exercises" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "muscle_group" TEXT NULL, "video_url" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "scheduled_exercises" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "exercise_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES exercises (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "scheduled_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sets" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reps" INTEGER NOT NULL, "weight_kg" REAL NULL, "rpe" INTEGER NULL, "comments" TEXT NULL, "feedback" TEXT NULL, "completed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("completed" IN (0, 1)), "recurrence_group_id" TEXT NULL, "repeat_days" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "repeat_forever" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("repeat_forever" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "disciplines" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "scheduled_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "duration_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "distance_km" REAL NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "feedback" TEXT NULL, "completed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("completed" IN (0, 1)), "recurrence_group_id" TEXT NULL, "repeat_days" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "repeat_forever" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("repeat_forever" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "step_logs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "steps" INTEGER NOT NULL, "date" INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "step_goals" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'singleton', "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "steps" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 8000, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "medications" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "dose" TEXT NULL, "schedule" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("active" IN (0, 1)), "active_from" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "medication_intakes" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "medication_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES medications (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "date" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "hydration_goals" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'singleton', "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "millilitres" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 2000, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "water_entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "millilitres" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "meditation_sessions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "vacation_periods" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "start_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_date" INTEGER NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "focus_sounds" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "url" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE INDEX habit_completion_lookup ON habit_completions (habit_id, completion_date)
CREATE INDEX streak_history_lookup ON streak_history_entries (streak_id, reached_at)
CREATE INDEX board_column_order ON board_columns (project_id, position)
CREATE INDEX task_project_lookup ON todo_tasks (project_id, column_id)
CREATE INDEX task_comment_lookup ON task_comments (task_id, created_at)
CREATE INDEX checklist_by_task ON task_checklist_items (task_id, position)
CREATE INDEX food_entry_by_day ON food_entries (date)
CREATE INDEX entry_item_by_entry ON food_entry_items (entry_id, position)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX food_by_name ON foods (lower_name)
CREATE INDEX scheduled_exercise_by_day ON scheduled_exercises (scheduled_date)
CREATE INDEX scheduled_exercise_by_group ON scheduled_exercises (recurrence_group_id)
CREATE INDEX discipline_by_day ON disciplines (scheduled_date)
CREATE INDEX discipline_by_group ON disciplines (recurrence_group_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX intake_by_day ON medication_intakes (date, medication_id)
CREATE INDEX water_by_day ON water_entries (date)
CREATE INDEX meditation_by_day ON meditation_sessions (date)
CREATE INDEX vacation_by_start ON vacation_periods (start_date)
